answer: Register one comet fragment recovery plot on a karst plateau. The applicant claims a single 100 metre square, walks it with a 250 dollar metal detector after each shower, and logs each find with photo and GPS stamp. A lab checks one fragment monthly against the intake record, while a gauge at the plot nadir logs the water table, so a later log fails. A forged plot forfeits a 150 token deposit and bars the applicant 180 days. Faking 10,000 plots freezes 1,500,000 tokens and costs 950,000 dollars. Like panning a dry creek for gold, the ground keeps the record and a liar finds only dust.
